# VRFBuildSettings

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Build` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Build/VRFBuildSettings.cs#L18)

The framework's half of a build profile: everything the VR Framework needs to know about a
build that Unity's own profile does not already carry.

Lives as a component on the profile asset, which is why there is no list of
configurations anywhere any more - the profile the user activates is the configuration,
and the build reads it from [`Active`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-build/VRFBuildProfiles#active) instead of asking.

## Properties

### InApplyOrder {#inapplyorder}

Settings in the order they are applied. Null entries are skipped: a setting whose class
was deleted or renamed deserializes as null, and losing one setting should not take the
build down with it.


### Validate(BuildProfile) {#validate-buildprofile}
